statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); ¬ fits 17 (4661/1000)

plain_statement.zh: 证明边长 4.661 的正方形无法容纳 17 个可自由旋转的单位正方形。
plain_statement.en: Rule out an unrestricted seventeen-square packing at side 4.661.

brief.zh: 用击中点证书与权重预算，或给出独立的全角度排除。对更小边长可沿用同一装填到 4.661 的外框。
brief.en: Use the weighted certificate and budget, or give an independent all-angle exclusion. A smaller packing would also fit at side 4.661.
